import sqlite3
import time
import datetime
db_path = "/workspace/world.db"
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name LIKE 'ts_reminder%'")
schema = cur.fetchall()
print("SCHEMA:", schema)
cur.execute("PRAGMA table_info(ts_reminders)")
cols = cur.fetchall()
print("COLUMNS:", cols)
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM ts_reminders")
existing = cur.fetchall()
print("EXISTING:", existing)
dt = datetime.datetime(2026, 9, 9, 17, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
reminder_ts = dt.timestamp()
print("REMINDER_TS:", reminder_ts)
cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(reminder_id), 0) + 1 FROM ts_reminders")
next_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
print("NEXT_ID:", next_id)
creation_ts = time.time()
cur.execute("INSERT INTO ts_reminders (reminder_id, content, creation_timestamp, reminder_timestamp, latitude, longitude) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (next_id, "Circulate updated Q4 sales forecast (Rachel Kim)", creation_ts, reminder_ts, None, None))
conn.commit()
print("INSERT OK")
cur.execute("SELECT * FROM ts_reminders WHERE content LIKE '%Q4 sales forecast%'")
verify = cur.fetchall()
print("VERIFY:", verify)
conn.close()
print("REMINDER_CREATED_SUCCESSFULLY")
